items.title: Owner Agent
items.description: Enables customers to do anything they can do with Owner's UI using natural language requests, and drives proactive actions for the customer to respond to, not just reacting to the customer.

items.title: AI Restaurant Grader

items.title: Categorization Assistant

items.title: Communications training program
